hook: One day left: who will control Congress?
caption:
🗳️ US midterms are tomorrow: all 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats. Results aren't final on election night.
🛢️ Iran talks in Qatar end with a draft deal circulating; Brent oil drops 4.2%. Fuel could ease if a deal holds.
🇧🇬 Iliana Iotova becomes Bulgaria's first elected female president.
✈️ A Learjet crash in Florida kills all nine aboard; the cause is under investigation.
🏎️ Kimi Antonelli, 20, is F1's youngest-ever world champion.
Which story surprised you most?
Follow @you.didnot.know for the daily brief.

Cover: One day left: who will control Congress?
📷 Diliff (CC BY 2.5) via wikimedia

1/5 US midterms are tomorrow (435)
All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats vote Tuesday. It decides who controls Congress for Trump's final two years.
📷 Martin Falbisoner (CC BY-SA 3.0) via wikimedia

2/5 Oil drops on Iran deal hopes (-4.2%)
Iran-Qatar talks ended with a draft US deal circulating. Brent oil fell 4.2% on hopes Hormuz could reopen.
📷 Frans Berkelaar (CC BY 2.0) via wikimedia

3/5 Bulgaria's first woman president (57.58%)
Acting President Iliana Iotova won the runoff with 57.58%. She's Bulgaria's first elected female head of state.
🎨 AI-generated image

4/5 Jet crash in Florida kills nine (9)
A Bahamas-bound Learjet 60 crashed in Greenacres, Florida. All nine aboard died; the cause is not yet known.
📷 Bill Abbott (CC BY-SA 2.0) via wikimedia

5/5 F1's youngest champion ever (20)
Kimi Antonelli, 20, clinched the F1 title in Mexico City. He's Italy's first world champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953.
